[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run2]
module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_lambda_function.scale_up builds a vpc_config from var.lambda_subnet_ids/var.lambda_security_group_ids, but it only depends on aws_iam_role.scale_up. module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_up_vpc_execution_role (which grants ec2:CreateNetworkInterface etc.) depends on the same role and subnet inputs and is therefore unordered relative to the function. Lambda rejects creation of a VPC-attached function whose execution role cannot create ENIs, so the function must be ordered after the attachment (add depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_up_vpc_execution_role]).

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
aws_lambda_function.scale_up uses a vpc_config but only references aws_iam_role.scale_up; it never depends on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_up_vpc_execution_role. Lambda creation will fail if the role lacks AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole at that moment, so the function must be ordered after the VPC execution-role attachment (e.g. via depends_on).

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run2]
module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_lambda_function.scale_down has a vpc_config but no ordering against module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_down_vpc_execution_role; both depend only on aws_iam_role.scale_down and the subnet/security-group inputs, so Terraform may create the VPC-attached function before its role can create ENIs (Lambda creation fails with "The provided execution role does not have permissions to call CreateNetworkInterface on EC2"). Add an explicit depends_on on the attachment.

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
aws_lambda_function.webhook is created with a vpc_config (subnet_ids/security_group_ids), but AWS Lambda requires the execution role to already have EC2 ENI permissions (AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole) at CreateFunction time, otherwise it fails with "The provided execution role does not have permissions to call CreateNetworkInterface on EC2". The function only references aws_iam_role.webhook_lambda, so it can be created before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.webhook_vpc_execution_role. Add a depends_on (or otherwise order) so the VPC execution-role attachment is created first.
